# Reference card V1 fixtures

- `Nereus_Reef_Reference_Card_V1_11x17_RGB_vector_crop_bleed.pdf` — the V1 vector print master,
  copied unchanged from `bm_cam_legacy/tools/` (commit 4b88669). `configs/cards/nereus_v1.yaml`
  is derived from it and pinned to it by `tests/unit/test_card_v1.py`.

The card on the `nereus002` rig (2026-09-28) is a V1 print.
